## SST: Sept - Oct (2014 - 2024)

::: {.panel-tabset}

### September SSTs (2014 - 2024) \

The **18°C SST isotherm shown as dark gray** contour line. \
The 45N, 140W lat/lon grid lines shown in gray. \

*Source: NOAA Coral Reef Watch Monthly SST (5km spatial resolution)*

![](docs/images/plot_monthly_sst_and_18C_isotherm_sept_2014_2024.png){group="clims"}

### October SSTs (2014 - 2024) \

The **18°C SST isotherm shown as dark gray** contour line. \
The 45N, 140W lat/lon grid lines shown in gray. \

*Source: NOAA Coral Reef Watch Monthly SST (5km spatial resolution)*

![](docs/images/plot_monthly_sst_and_18C_isotherm_oct_2014_2024.png){group="clims"}

::: 

<br>
<br>
